verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical, and both have the same flaws. The product bottle is shrunk to a tiny icon and stranded bottom-left. The 'Longest Day Sale' ribbon is small and floats loose. The subcopy is wrapped into a narrow, cramped column that crowds the CTA. The legal text is squeezed into a tiny column jammed against the right edge, and a background dot overlaps the 'sunset' line. The left half reads as empty and unbalanced next to an overstuffed right half.
